parameters.name: AutoscalerEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable Auto Scaling for the service.

parameters.name: CallerUid
parameters.description: The UID of the account that created the service.

parameters.name: CronscalerEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable scheduled auto scaling for the service.

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: The keyword for a fuzzy search. This parameter supports fuzzy searches by service name only.

parameters.name: Gateway
parameters.description: The private gateway ID.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the service group. To learn how to obtain this name, see [ListServices](~~412109~~).

parameters.name: IncludeNoWorkspace
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include services that do not belong to any workspace. The default value is true.

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: Filters services by label.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- `desc` (default): descending.

- `asc`: ascending.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the results to return. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of services to return per page. The default value is 100.

parameters.name: ParentServiceUid
parameters.description: The UID of the primary service. This parameter applies to member services in a service group.

parameters.name: QuotaId
parameters.description: The quota ID.

parameters.name: ResourceAliasName
parameters.description: The custom name of the resource group.

parameters.name: ResourceBurstable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable a burstable resource pool for the service.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group. To learn how to query for this ID, see [ListResources](~~412133~~).

parameters.name: ResourceName
parameters.description: The name or ID of the service's resource group.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of resource the service uses. Valid values:

- PublicResource

- DedicatedResource

- Lingjun

- SelfManagedLingjun

parameters.name: Role
parameters.description: The service role.

parameters.name: ServiceName
parameters.description: The service name.

parameters.name: ServiceStatus
parameters.description: The status of the service.

parameters.name: ServiceType
parameters.description:
The service type. Valid values:

- Async

- Standard

- Queue

- LLM

- RAG

- Serverless

- LLMGatewayService

- OfflineTask

- SDCluster

- ScalableJob

- ScalableJobService

- AssistantJob

parameters.name: ServiceUid
parameters.description: The service UID.

parameters.name: Sort
parameters.description: The sort field. By default, results are sorted by timestamp in descending order.

parameters.name: TrafficState
parameters.description: Specifies whether the service accepts group traffic. This parameter applies only to services within a service group.

parameters.name: WorkspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace ID.
